messages.content: Write me a short script that lists the HDF5 files in the source folder, newest first.

Here is a script you can run from the Code Editor or keep in your saved scripts:

```python
"""List the HDF5 files in the source folder, newest first."""
from pathlib import Path

folder = Path("/tmp/aida-docs/data/usaxs-2026-11")
files = sorted(folder.glob("*.h5"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime, reverse=True)
for f in files:
    print(f"{f.name:28s} {f.stat().st_size / 1024:6.1f} KB")
```

It only reads file names, sizes and modification times; it does not open the files.
